title: RecipeTin's Chinese Beef Stir Fry
ingredients: Beef & Velveting: 200g flank/rump steak, 1/2 tsp baking soda
Sauce: 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 2 tbsp cooking wine, 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp sesame oil, 1 pinch white pepper
Stir-fry base: 3 tsp cornstarch, 1/2 cup water, 1.5 tbsp peanut oil
Aromatics: 1 clove garlic minced, 1/2 small onion sliced
Veggies: 1/2 red capsicum, 1 small carrot sliced, 2 bok choy
Garnish: 2 green onions chopped, sesame seeds
steps: Coat beef with baking soda, rest for 20 minutes, rinse well under tap water, and pat dry.
Mix sauce ingredients, reserve 1.5 tablespoons to coat beef, and whisk cornstarch and water into remainder.
Heat peanut oil in a wok over high heat, add onion and garlic, and cook for 10 seconds.
Add beef and stir-fry until color changes from red to light brown but center remains slightly pink.
Toss in capsicum, carrots, bok choy stems, and white onion, cooking for 1 minute before pouring sauce.
Add bok choy leaves and green onions, tossing 1 minute until wilted and glossy, then serve with rice.
